statement: For the actual arithmetic h and fixed-parameter source of D49, the remaining moving module over the actual G3 is lifted through the entire two-adic homology tower of K3. The exact image of the D49 source kernel is the integral direct summand U-minus, with rank |G3|/6*(1-1/|A|), and the full common marked quotient is J-infinity/U-minus. A first peripheral endomorphism is repaired to an automorphism by the actual regular-edge-module Fitting projection, an explicit crossed homomorphism and a cyclic norm correction. All higher common quotients and simultaneous conjugators are computed, giving a compatible continuous automorphism on the exact source Bhat/(R_h intersect K_infinity). This source strictly enlarges D49, with projection kernel U-minus, while retaining its complete action, parameter, CM pair, full metabelian action and congruence action. The remaining full-source kernel has a proved nonzero image containing W1 wedge V in the next actual class-two exponent-four quotient; the explicit commutators and its dimension are given.
